title: Radicial preparation fibre comparison
statement: For arbitrary scheme morphisms f:X→T and r:S→T, let h:Y→X×_T S [def-pc-fibre-product] be a universal homeomorphism [def-weil-universal-homeomorphism]. Put g=h followed by projection to S. For every s∈S, the g-fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre] is geometrically irreducible [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible] if and only if the f-fibre at r(s) is geometrically irreducible. Neither finiteness nor a generic-point hypothesis is required.

source.place: Lemma 37.27.2 in Section 37.27 (Tag 0553), and Tag 04DF; applied in Tag 0559.

proof.text: After any field-valued base change a universal homeomorphism h gives a homeomorphism. Pullback pasting and Homeomorph.irreducibleSpace_iff prove geometric irreducibility is unchanged by precomposition with h.

Geometric irreducibility descends along any field extension: use a common extension of the new base field and an arbitrary test field. Irreducibility there descends via the continuous surjective projection to the test-field base change. The converse is base-change stability.

Mathlib isPullback_fiberToSpecResidueField_of_isPullback identifies the pullback-family fibre with the base change of the original fibre along the residue field map. Apply the preceding field-extension equivalence and the source universal-homeomorphism equivalence.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_radicial_preparation_fibre_comparison
    {X T S Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T) (r : S ⟶ T)
    (h : Y ⟶ pullback f r) [IsUniversalHomeomorphism h] (s : S) :
    GeometricallyIrreducible ((h ≫ pullback.snd f r).fiberToSpecResidueField s) ↔
      GeometricallyIrreducible (f.fiberToSpecResidueField (r s))
